reports.title: CoStar Group Reports Record Third Quarter Revenue of $952 Million;

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The Company is increasing its Adjusted EBITDA guidance for the full year of 2026 to a range of $820 million to $840 million, which represents an increase of $30 million at the midpoint of the range from its guidance in July 2026, and a cumulative $60 million increase at the midpoint from its guidance in February 2026. For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $275 million to $295 million, representing a margin of 29% at the midpoint of the range.

The Company is increasing its revenue guidance for 2026 to a range of $3.75 billion to $3.77 billion, representing revenue growth of approximately 16% year-over-year at the midpoint of the range. The Company expects revenue for the fourth quarter of 2026 in the range of $976 million to $996 million, representing revenue growth of approximately 10% year-over-year at the midpoint of the range.

The Company is increasing its full year 2026 Adjusted EPS guidance in a range of $1.38 to $1.41 based on 405 million shares. For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects Adjusted EPS in a range of $0.46 to $0.50 based on 400 million shares. These ranges include an estimated non-GAAP tax rate of 26% for the full year and the fourth quarter of 2026.
